newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan electronics up on foreign fund buying.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan electronics up on foreign fund buying.

text.p: Taiwan's electronic shares rose sharply in active, mid-morning trade on Tuesday on possible buying from foreign funds, brokers said.

With 80 minutes left, the most active issue, Acer Inc, jumped T$1.4 or 3.74 percent to T$38.8. Taiwan Semiconductor was up 50 cents or 0.9 percent to T$56 and Mitac International gained 30 cents or 1.36 percent to T$22.3.
"It looks like some new foreign equity funds are buying the electronic blue chips," said Lin Long-hsien of United Securities.
Many foreign funds are expected to enter the island or increase their Taiwan portfolio after Morgan Stanley's inclusion of Taiwan into its global indices from Monday, brokers said.
